hook.name: LiquidHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook with volatility-based dynamic LP fees adjusted per-swap using tick movement relative to a reference price, plus a 20% protocol fee collected via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas. Supports an optional MEV protection module active for up to 2 minutes after pool creation and an optional pool extension for post-swap callbacks.
